create_Replicator: create a Replicator instance to replicate input, parameters and compute over multiple GPUs
create_TpuReplicator: create a TpuReplicator instance to replicate input, parameters and compute over multiple TPUs
create_CrossReplicaBatchNorm: create a CrossReplicaBatchNorm module to calculate batch statistics across all replicas in a distributed setting
create_variables_eagerly: create variables eagerly within a TpuReplicator scope using an initial value
run_replicator_forward: run a forward function in parallel on all accelerator devices using replicator.run
